name: Arrow Wire & Cable Inc
old_description: Our customer's satisfaction is paramount to our success. Every customer is important and each job is unique. Arrow is about People, Partnerships and Solutions.
about:
Arrow Wire & Cable was founded in 1989 in Phoenix, Arizona, to serve low‑voltage integrators and the telecommunications industry with quality product solutions. The company operates as an independent distributor with a corporate facility in Chino, California, and additional stocking locations in Hayward, California, and Phoenix, Arizona.

The firm distributes wire, cable, connectivity components, and security products from a broad roster of manufacturing partners. It maintains millions of feet of category cable in stock and offers custom cable assembly, same‑day shipping on stocked items, will‑call pickup, on‑site customer training, and continuing‑education certification programs. Three strategically placed West Coast locations support rapid fulfillment across California and Arizona.

Arrow serves commercial, industrial, communications, OEM, government, and security markets. Its customer base includes contractors, end users, system integrators, and design consultants who rely on the distributor for low‑voltage and telecommunications infrastructure.

The company states its mission is to be the leading service distributor in California and Arizona, emphasizing personal attention, collaborative planning with customers, and close coordination with vendor technical teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
